arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/leads-docs-alignment.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git -c credential.helper= clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
echo COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo DOCUMENT_FILES
git ls-files '*.md' '*.yml' '*.yaml' '*.json' | head -95
echo BOOTSTRAP
sed -n '1,160p' docs/BOOTSTRAP.md
echo CONFLICT_CANDIDATES
grep -RInE 'um grupo por dia|1 grupo por dia|one group per day|group[_ -]joins.*[12]|group[_ -]daily[_ -]limit|MAX_GROUP_JOINS|por conta por dia|group per account per day|rotativ|join request|ades[aã]o|volunt[aá]ri' --include='*.md' --exclude='BOOTSTRAP.md' README* docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -100
echo ENTRYPOINT_REFERENCES
grep -RInE 'BOOTSTRAP|FRAMEWORK|source.of.truth|fonte de verdade|source of truth' --include='*.md' README* docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -60
echo DONE
